help_me.reply: 💛 I am really sorry you feel this way, and I am glad you told someone. You are not alone and it is not your fault. Please tell a trusted adult right now: a parent, guardian, teacher or church leader. In Zimbabwe you can also call Childline on 116 (free) to talk to someone who cares. If you are in danger right now, go to a safe grown-up immediately.
